content: The test image shows soybean plants in a field with widespread yellowing/chlorosis, interveinal yellowing on leaves, and some browning — characteristic of a systemic disease. Top candidates: Sudden_death_syndrome, Brown_Stem_Rot, Soybean_Cyst_Nematode.

- Test image: field-level view, rows of soybean with widespread interveinal yellowing/chlorosis, mixed green and yellow-brown plants, sandy soil
- SDS refs (268, 39): classic interveinal chlorosis — yellow/brown between veins, green veins intact — matches the yellowing tone in the test image
- BSR ref (18): very similar leaf symptoms to SDS, but BSR typically shows less patchy field distribution
- The patchy field-level distribution with some plants more affected than others aligns more with SDS
- Cyst nematode, Phytophthora, Green stem disorder all ruled out — wrong symptom type

SDS is the best match based on field appearance and the interveinal chlorosis pattern visible even at field scale.
